description:
[measured, RISK AHEAD, Hyperliquid] REAL open positions on Hyperliquid binned by the
    liquidation price the exchange itself reports: the 10,000 largest accounts plus every account
    seen trading since the reader started (about 13,600 accounts, ~40-45% of venue open interest, stated
    in covered_long_pct/covered_short_pct). Not a model. Use this for Hyperliquid; use
    get_lighter_liquidation_map for Lighter and get_liquidation_map (modeled) for the CEXs.
    Returns long/short notional per bin, cumulative curves and the largest positions. range: 12h
    | 1d | 3d | 7d | max (±100%, recommended: large accounts run low leverage).
    PRICE: the full map is a metered call ($0.005, or a key). Without a key this tool returns the
    free summary: USD on each side of the price and the largest level on each side.

range.description: Price range around the current price: 12h | 1d | 3d | 7d (and 'max' where stated), the traded range of that window.
range.title: Range

symbol.description: Contract as BASEUSDT, e.g. BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT (1000PEPE and kPEPE fold to PEPEUSDT).
symbol.title: Symbol
